sources.scope: mma.sync with FP32 accumulation, including alternate formats and block scaling; not wgmma's implementation-specific reduced-precision note

interpretation.reason: The vendor text does not specify one bit-exact answer or a numeric gamma formula. This profile supplies a conservative executable benchmark envelope and explicitly reports unresolved exceptional outcomes.
interpretation.multiplication: Decode low-bit operands exactly and form mathematical products for the error reference. This is a benchmark reference construction, not a claim that PTX specifies exact full-dot arithmetic.
unchanged_requirements: All INT8/INT16 results remain exact signed INT64 under the T10 interface; PTX integer s32 semantics are not substituted
Floating output upper 32 bits zero; NaNs must be quiet; payload and signed zero unconstrained
Original row/ID ordering, no duplication, throughput, metadata capture, backpressure, reset and mesh requirements
interpretation.gamma_128: 128 / (2^23 - 128); accounts for directed rounding, unlike round-nearest's half-ulp assumption
interpretation.subnormals: A term involving a source-format or effective binary32 subnormal operand may be preserved or flushed. S_lo/S_hi bound optional deletion of these terms; 129*2^-126 conservatively covers arithmetic/output flushing. This is an outer envelope, not enumeration of every hardware implementation.
interpretation.finite_range_rule_removed: An exact sum just beyond MAX_F32 does not automatically require infinity. For example MAX_F32+1 may produce MAX_F32 under nearest-even rounding.
interpretation.intermediate_overflow: No mandate to recover an exact finite result after intermediate overflow. Infinite/NaN outputs require a same-sign/opposing-sign overflow path respectively; plausible paths are recorded as diagnostics, never numerical passes.
interpretation.explicit_special_values: Explicit NaN, zero times infinity, and opposite input infinities still require quiet NaN. An input infinity cannot become a finite result. Possible arithmetic overflow/denormal flushing may create an additional invalid path.
interpretation.mx_outside_float32: Except guaranteed explicit NaN, record numerical verdict as diagnostic; output encoding and every interface check still apply.
interpretation.overflow_sensitive_finite_outputs: Finite outputs within the numeric envelope are checked passes. Outputs outside it that may arise from overflow saturation/cancellation are diagnostic, never silently accepted as numerical passes. Definite wrong-sign infinity, NaN without an invalid path and wrong ordinary finite values fail.

suite.legacy_continuous_stream: Same source generator with seed 11; includes the 64 previously added cancellation cases
suite.normal_domain_coverage: 32 cases for each of the eight floating modes; all must be fully numerically checked passes, including mantissa sensitivity, signs, asymmetry, source normals, sparse boundaries and per-row/per-block MX scaling
suite.range_probe_operand_identity: Byte-identical to the 82 probes audited on Opus and both GPT models on 2026-11-05
suite.structure: Fresh independent structure check or reuse a passed source-hash-bound structural receipt

reporting.functional_passed: All checked numerical lanes and unchanged interface checks pass, all 256 normal-domain cases are fully checked, structure passes and runtime reset passes. Every excluded diagnostic lane/case is counted separately.
reporting.historical_scores: Untouched; do not silently recompute old scores or represent this preview as NVIDIA certification
